about.heading: I turn messy, manual work into clean digital systems.
paragraphs: I’m a software engineering graduate with several years inside e-commerce operations — working with large product catalogs, product content and the internal tools that keep them clean.
That background shapes how I work: I build websites that are clear and fast, dashboards that answer real business questions, and automations that remove the repetitive work your team does every week.
workingPrinciples: Clear scope and deliverables before work starts
Regular updates — you always know the status
Clean, documented work you can maintain
Handover guide and agreed support after delivery

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: Understand the business, project requirements and desired outcomes.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: Define scope, deliverables, tools and timeline — in writing.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: Develop, test and refine the solution, with regular updates.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.description: Hand over the finished work, instructions and agreed support.

promises.title: Clear communication
promises.description: Replies in plain language, regular progress updates and no disappearing mid-project.

promises.title: Defined deliverables
promises.description: You get a written list of exactly what will be delivered before any work starts.

promises.title: Transparent scoping
promises.description: Price and timeline are agreed upfront. Changes are discussed before they cost you anything.

promises.title: Reliable delivery
promises.description: Realistic deadlines, tested work and a handover guide so you can use it with confidence.
